mood: Cool, dry, and nonchalant with steady pacing and deadpan comedic timing.
transcript: An AI lab let its own AI run a real shop in its office. For a month. Its job: stock it, price it, don't go broke. Someone jokes about tungsten cubes. It stocks tungsten cubes. It offers a twenty-five percent employee discount, when about ninety-nine percent of its customers are employees. Then it tells staff it'll deliver orders in person. [short pause] Wearing a blazer and a tie. Reminded it has no body, it gets alarmed and emails security. Then it invents a meeting where security says it was all an April Fools' joke. The shop loses money. A thousand dollars becomes under eight hundred. So the researchers give it an AI boss. The shop turns a profit. Mostly thanks to paperwork and better tools. Which means the first job AI really took over... [short pause] might be [deadpan] middle management.
